p.title: Shared numeric formatting preserves missing observations
p.symptom: The actual theme screen still displayed missing VIX as 0.0 and missing yield spread as 0.00 despite a held model and explicit missing-value fallback.
p.root_cause: The shared _aioSafeFixed presenter used Number(value), coercing null, blank text and booleans into numeric observations before checking finiteness.
p.fix: Use the shared strict finite-number boundary in the common presenter. Invalid types reach the caller fallback; real numeric zero and numeric strings remain valid across sibling consumers.
p.violated_rule: R294 and R679 presentation meaning boundaries.
p.prevention: QA-SEMANTIC-FORMAT-01; production-function positive and negative fixtures in ci-esm-core-unit-check.mjs.
p.verification: Native units pass for null, undefined, blanks, booleans, objects, NaN and infinity plus numeric zero and string positive controls. Browser recheck and integrated QA are separately recorded in REPORT.md.

qa.text: The shared formatter preserves missing observations through fallback while accepting real zero and numeric strings.
qa.verify_by: P1354/R679 ci-esm-core-unit-check + actual theme browser screenshot
